senses.sense_definition: To overthrow or destroy a system or institution completely.

examples.text: The rebels plotted to <w>subvert</w> the government and establish a new regime.
External forces attempted to <w>subvert</w> the nation's democratic foundations.

senses.sense_definition: To corrupt or undermine someone's morals, beliefs, or loyalty.

examples.text: They tried to <w>subvert</w> the youth by spreading false information.
The propaganda was designed to <w>subvert</w> the public's trust in the media.

senses.sense_definition: To challenge or undermine established conventions or expectations.

examples.text: The artist used satire to <w>subvert</w> traditional gender roles in her work.
The novel aims to <w>subvert</w> the reader's expectations of a happy ending.

senses.sense_definition: An advertisement that has been altered to convey a message critical of the original product or company.

examples.text: The activists placed a <w>subvert</w> on the billboard to protest corporate greed.
Many people find the clever <w>subvert</w> more thought-provoking than the original ad.
